note: I will extol you my God and King; great is the LORD and greatly to be praised; on the splendor of your majesty I meditate; the LORD is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, abounding in steadfast love; good to all; righteous in all his ways; near to all who call; he fulfills the desire of those who fear him; the LORD preserves all who love him, but the wicked he destroys
